releases.displayName: Another little update for you all - now you can jump through time in NG+!

notes.title: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42519171/b928d41f58dcc3e49bbd1ed8c9f3f128560dc286.png"]Hey all! Another little update for you all - now you can jump through time in NG+!

items.text: By accessing the planner you can choose a day and time to warp to, if you want to speed around the game to access specific moments. Because of how our flag system works, you can't go back in time, only forward. But still, pretty nice?

notes.title: This is only accessible after you've beaten the game once, of course.

items.text: Here's some video of the planner in action.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42519171/3de6debdba66a16d553248c9c4122d5f687191aa.gif"]

Also, we've made a minor ending change, which is only relevant to new players. Now, regardless of how many relationships you've built, a new player's first ending will always be Namako's. This is what we view as the canon ending, and it has the most emotional impact. Frankly, it should've been this way at launch, to avoid someone accidentally choosing a "goofy" ending to the game, which can cheapen the experience. Once you've gone through her ending, all the others become available as normal. And of course, if you've already beaten the game this doesn't affect you at all.

Hello all! Thanks for all the support you've given Demonschool so far. It's been lovely to hear from folks who see themselves in these characters, people who vibe with the battle mechanics, and folks who just like hanging out in this world.

As we hinted in our last update, there were a few more things we had wanted to do with the game if we had extra time. So we decided to reward everyone with a nice update. We want to be clear about what this is and isn't - this is a quality of life update with a bunch of extra interactive details, not a major story update. But there's enough here that we hope folks will get something out of it.

You can now start a New Game+ from your completed save file. This allows you to play through the game from the start with all abilities, opals, credits, relationships, clubhouse styles, clubhouse upgrades and fish gained through past playthroughs.
All characters are playable from the first point at which you have a full team (late week 10). This means you can use characters in battles where they weren't meant to be.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42519171/57db5d0af38d90c906828902af0706171c63da4f.jpg"]

Faye mentions in the early game that there's a pretzel she wants to buy in the alley. We promised that if we hit 500 reviews, we'd let Faye buy one. And so: now Faye can buy a pretzel from the alley starting week 9 on Mondays.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42519171/c6acd7d8be712383d50fc3523036cdf50c1a6927.png"]

Forming connections between non-Faye characters now prompts short, two-line dialog interactions (around the clubhouse). There are 182 of these interactions, two per character combination. These connections are formed (as mentioned in the help menu) by completing battles with the characters between whom you want to form a bond. They just need to be in the same battle together. These interactions are just a short little extra bit of color.

There are now more than double the number of character lines in the clubhouse. Previously, our characters would only have something new to say when something happened in that particular week. Now they also react to whatever clubhouse style they're in, depending on the action they're doing. So, essentially, more goofy lines of text in the clubhouse.
Fulfilling another big request, we've added a text log for those that want to read over older conversations. The last 20 lines of dialog will be available.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42519171/a57586dcf74202912b141d94dc2b2051d2d4dd80.png"]
We have sped up and improved the cutscene actions and character sprite movements in several weeks, focusing especially on some of the slower weeks pacing-wise.
We've gone through and done a grammar check through the main story and NPCs. In particular we checked for comma and period usage. Sidequests and connections may get this treatment at a later time.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42519171/b8e6511757b10b04790532d8c66dd4e3b5d83ce9.png"]

We've added mouse-only control for the game. You can now play the entire game with just the mouse. You can left-click and Faye will run to that location, or you can right-click and drag, and she'll follow the cursor around.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42519171/13163efc64b250f8c39af765a4b21df9c2fc43a4.gif"]
There are tons of fixes to minigames, battles, achievements, abilities, et cetera.

Thank you for playing Demonschool, both new players and old! And if you've never reviewed the game, please do! Negative reviews have a huge amount of power on Steam, and they increase whenever we do a sale, as we're doing right now. We need many positive reviews to lift us above them.
We hope you enjoy the updates!

We've been working away based on bug reports and our own feature adds, and as of the latest build, here's what we've done:
The store is in now so you have somewhere to spend your opals (check the alley). not everything will be available at first.
Added rare "dire" variants of all fish since folks seem to be enjoying the fishing minigame
The fish music now resumes if you continue fishing within a few seconds.
Fixed a few battle bugs. since the underlying systems are quite complex we do sometimes get odd edge cases, so keep reporting these if you find them (with video if possible!)
Hopefully squashed all UI locks. menus were stacking on top of each other causing a few softlocks, but these should be sorted now.
Fixed some mesh/boundary issues
There's still (a little) more to come and more bug fixes as we find them, so stay tuned, and thanks for playing!
Oh, and to be clear, we've gotten a few questions and yes - anyone can stream the game who would like to! We encourage it!
